settings.label: Client ID
settings.description: The OAuth client ID from your GitHub OAuth app, whose callback URL is http://127.0.0.1:51789/callback.

settings.label: Client secret
settings.description: The client secret of the same GitHub OAuth app. GitHub's web flow requires it to exchange the code, even with PKCE.

capabilities.reason: Reads the signed-in user and is the host of the Account this Plugin provides.
Exchanges the OAuth authorization code for a token.
